generation: v4 (fourth generation of the Jev-Style decision series)

converted_from.what: the language model of the released checkpoint (the vision tower is not part of these files)

architecture: Qwen3_5ForCausalLM, text only: the language model of the released Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (24 layers: 18 Gated DeltaNet + 6 full attention, hidden 2048, tied embeddings, 1,881,825,088 parameters)
inputs: text and JSON states only; images need the main repository's PyTorch runtime
attention: block-causal in the 6 full-attention layers: the input is cut into [start, stop) blocks of at most block_size tokens (state blocks; one short question block, or catalogue blocks + rubric blocks when question + options + slots exceed block_size); every block attends to all earlier tokens and to itself with no causal mask inside the block. Gated-DeltaNet layers are ordinary recurrent layers.

calibration.fitted_on: 3,325 held-out calibration rows (not training, not dev rows)

text_only_export.script: scripts/formats/make_text_only.py (renames model.language_model.* -> model.*, drops model.visual.*; same tensors, bf16)
text_only_export.reproduced: byte-identical on the Mac and on the Colab VM (model.safetensors sha256 above)

results: benchmark results are on the main model card; they were measured with the main repository's PyTorch runtime, which these files reproduce within format_gates below

weights.*/macjev_norms_fp32.safetensors: exact FP32 (1 + w) of the 61 shifted Qwen3.5 RMSNorms (format macjev-norms-fp32-v1); required by the runtime

conversion.recipe: 1 (pre-declared primary: mlx_lm.convert defaults + the FP32 norm sidecar)
commands: mlx_lm.convert(<staging: text-only export, model_type qwen3_5>, bf16/, dtype='bfloat16')
mlx_lm.convert(<staging>, 8bit/, quantize=True, q_bits=8, q_group_size=64, q_mode='affine', dtype='bfloat16')
conversion.tokenizer: tokenizer.json / tokenizer_config.json kept byte-identical to the main repository

runtime.mlx_lm_required: 0.31.3 (exact; the runtime checks the sha256 of the mlx-lm source it patches and refuses other versions)

mlx_lm_corrections.gdn_qk_l2norm: Gated-DeltaNet q/k normalised with l2norm eps 1e-6 (HF / fla / llama.cpp) instead of mlx-lm's rms_norm eps 1e-6 (= l2norm eps Dk*1e-6); per-instance class swap
mlx_lm_corrections.rmsnorm_fp32_shift: Qwen3.5 (1 + w) RMSNorm weights taken in FP32 from macjev_norms_fp32.safetensors instead of the bf16-rounded (1 + w) stored by mlx-lm's converter; norms computed in FP32 and cast back

runtime.state_reuse: score_many(state, questions) computes the state blocks once and runs every question on a copy of that cache; the last state is kept, so consecutive calls / JSONL rows with an identical state reuse it
runtime.shared_files: readout_config.json (readout + one calibration temperature per question type), release_config.json and manifest.json are shared by both precisions; each precision folder has its own config.json, tokenizer, weights and norm sidecar

bf16.mlx_compute_dtype_note: native activations (bf16 residual stream; norms and readout in FP32), the setting the release scoring used

8bit.mlx_compute_dtype_note: native activations, the setting the release scoring used

removed_vs_0.8b_runtime.--category: no group temperatures: one per question type
removed_vs_0.8b_runtime.--head-max: no question/options cap: only the 32,768-token total budget; long question+options use the catalogue-overflow layout
removed_vs_0.8b_runtime.option chunking: not needed: all options are always scored in one input

runtime.temperature: readout_config.json temperatures.by_qtype (choice / noul / score) unless overridden
runtime.images: not supported (text only): use the main repository's PyTorch runtime

predeclared.declared: 2026-10-28 00:10 AEDT (fixture sha256 corrected 00:13, before any scoring)

format_gates.reference:
Reference scores for the v4 format gates (2026-10-28; Colab GPU): the main repository's reference scorer in float32
(V4Engine loading path -> RendererV2 rows -> train.evaluate.score_rows, exact block attention) on the fixtures, plus
the two attention controls of the block-mask proof on the base fixture (same weights, rows and readout; only the
full-attention layers' mask changes):

latency_m1_max.what: wall time of one runtime call during the fixture run (Apple M1 Max, 64 GB, macOS 15.7.5; the machine was otherwise in normal use, so indicative)

root_config_json: copy of bf16/config.json at the repository root so the Hub counts downloads; the runtime treats the root as the repository folder (it has bf16/ and 8bit/ but no model.safetensors) and loads bf16/ or 8bit/
decision_index: not run with these files; the main repository's Decision Index numbers come from its PyTorch runtime (bfloat16)
